obligations.title: Provide project status reporting for the duration of the SOW.
Nominate a project manager as the Customer's primary contact.
Nominate a project sponsor as the Supplier's primary contact.
Have the project manager and sponsor meet or confer at reasonable intervals to review progress, risks and issues.
Provide a written impact assessment of any requested change on Fees, timetable and Services.
Maintain appropriate technical and organisational security measures for Customer personal data.
obligations.clause_heading: Confidentiality, Intellectual Property and Data Protection

obligations.title: Return or destroy the other party's Confidential Information on expiry or termination.
